summary: Completed testing of Rankings and Friends features in QUESTEDUCA. All 18 backend API tests pass. Frontend UI for Rankings tab (school/district/national) and Friends tab (search/add friend) renders correctly. Fixed MongoDB ObjectId serialization bug in /api/game/state endpoint.

fixed_bugs.issue: MongoDB ObjectId serialization error in /api/game/state endpoint
fixed_bugs.fix: Added game_state.pop('_id', None) after insert_one to remove MongoDB _id field
fixed_bugs.impact: 500 error when creating new game state for student

passed_tests: API /api/rankings/national returns ranking data with entries, total_players, user_position
API /api/friends/search returns potential friends with user_id, nickname, school_name, level
API /api/friends/request to valid user succeeds with request_id
Frontend: Rankings tab renders with header, description, and 3 ranking type buttons
Frontend: Rankings tab shows 'Minha Escola', 'Meu Distrito', 'Nacional' buttons
Frontend: National ranking shows user position (#49 de 49) and ranking entries
Frontend: Ranking entries show rank, nickname, school, district, XP, settlement level
Frontend: Friends tab renders with header, search bar, and 'Os Meus Amigos' section
Frontend: Friends search returns results with nickname, school, level, and add friend button
Frontend: Empty states show appropriate messages for no rankings/friends
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed: MongoDB ObjectId serialization issue in /api/game/state - was causing 500 errors for new students
Rankings API correctly aggregates data from students and game_states collections
Friends API properly handles friend requests with parent notification system
seed_data_creation: Test student accounts created via API for UI testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rankings and Friends features fully implemented and tested. Rankings show school/district/national leaderboards with XP-based sorting. Friends feature includes search by nickname/school and friend request system with parent approval workflow. MongoDB ObjectId bug fixed in game state creation.
